selection: 'tasks' (dev set): smoke task fix-git plus 4 easy/medium tasks with small amd64 images, 900s agent timeouts and offline verifiers. Relay improvements were developed against failures observed on this set. 'heldout_tasks': 5 further easy/medium tasks fixed BEFORE any held-out run and never used for tuning; they measure whether improvements generalize. Neither set is a random sample.
